milestone.title: Typed lifecycle transitions and model normalization

intent.outcome: mp-model owns a typed MilestoneEvent transition table; mp is the sole durable executor; Raul consumes shared projections; legacy nested step IDs cannot produce duplicates; remediation restores the exact prior lifecycle.

problem.description: Lifecycle is an allowlist, not a transition table, so set-lifecycle allows arbitrary jumps and terminal regressions. Raul duplicates legacy mapping and maps exec done to complete while mp-model maps it to non-terminal done. Remediation collapses distinct origins. normalize_steps_from_disk can accept duplicate nested step IDs.

in_scope: Typed MilestonePhase, overlays, MilestoneEvent, and pure transition() in mp-model
CLI commands submit events; raw assignment is migration-only
Reviews registry solely owns review-cycle verdicts; self-reviewed/reviewed are legacy aliases
Reject duplicate legacy step IDs; exact remediation pre-state restore
out_of_scope: Watch driver/prompt alignment and Raul preflight/idle (Group D)
Annotation cursor and co-approval UX (Group E)

acceptance_criteria.description: mp-model owns typed MilestonePhase, overlays, MilestoneEvent, and pure transition(current, event, context) -> Result<TransitionEffects>; exhaustive valid/invalid transitions reject arbitrary jumps (including draft->complete and complete->draft) and synchronize lifecycle/spec/execution projections; normalize_steps_from_disk rejects duplicate legacy nested step IDs with both locations, preserving top-level precedence only for supported migration inputs.

Raul has no duplicate legacy lifecycle derivation: Value adapters extract fields and delegate to mp-model; legacy execution_status done maps to nonterminal lifecycle done (not complete); tui_status_parity compares Raul output to mp-model across the documented matrix including unknown, empty, cancelled, blocked, deferred, and in-progress.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test tui_status_parity --no-fail-fast: 10 passed

acceptance_criteria.description: mp is the sole durable transition executor: public lifecycle CLI paths submit MilestoneEvents instead of assigning lifecycle strings; raw set-lifecycle remains migration-only; legacy spec/execution setters cannot bypass transition gates or terminal regressions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test lifecycle_setter_overlay --no-fail-fast: 19 passed

acceptance_criteria.description: Reviews registry solely owns self/external review-cycle state; self-reviewed and reviewed are legacy read/migration aliases not active destinations; remediation captures the exact pre-state lifecycle and restores that value when findings clear (done->remediation->done and complete->remediation->complete); invalid remediation origins are rejected.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test lifecycle_complete_ceremony --no-fail-fast: 14 passed

acceptance_criteria.description: End-to-end lifecycle reliability holds after the shared transition table: all-steps-done complete path, stuck-exec warnings, and reviews-pass promotion remain consistent with mp-model projections.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test transition_reliability --no-fail-fast: 17 passed

acceptance_criteria.description: Review-side mutation paths (findings, remediation entry/exit, review_state) stay consistent with the shared transition executor and reviews-registry ownership.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test suite_review --no-fail-fast: 67 passed

acceptance_criteria.description: mp crate with tests compiles under Clippy with warnings denied after transition-executor wiring.
mp-model crate with tests compiles under Clippy with warnings denied after typed phase/event/transition and normalize changes.
raul crate with tests compiles under Clippy with warnings denied after lifecycle projection delegation.

design_decisions.choice: mp-model owns typed MilestonePhase, overlays, MilestoneEvent, and pure transition(current, event, context) -> Result<TransitionEffects>; mp is the sole durable executor that applies TransitionEffects to disk; CLI raw lifecycle assignment is migration-only.
design_decisions.rationale: LIFECYCLE_STATES is an allowlist; set-lifecycle and legacy setters currently allow arbitrary jumps and terminal regressions with no single owner.

design_decisions.choice: Self/external review-cycle state lives solely in the reviews registry; self-reviewed and reviewed become legacy read/migration aliases, not active milestone destinations; delivery phases stay small with complete as terminal delivery.
design_decisions.rationale: Reviews, Watch, completion, and raw setters each owned part of review rungs, producing contradictory lifecycles (Group C Finding 13 / Group D decision alignment).

design_decisions.choice: Raul removes duplicate legacy lifecycle mapping and delegates derivation to mp-model (Value adapters extract fields only); legacy execution_status done maps to nonterminal lifecycle done.
design_decisions.rationale: Raul currently mirrors and diverges from mp-model, mapping exec done to complete while mp-model maps it to done.

design_decisions.choice: Entering remediation captures the exact current lifecycle as remediation_pre_state (after validating an allowed origin) and restores exactly that value when relevant findings clear; behavior lives in the shared transition function.
design_decisions.rationale: Current reviews code hard-codes done/self-reviewed on entry, collapsing complete->remediation back to done.

design_decisions.choice: normalize_steps_from_disk mutably tracks every accepted nested step ID, rejects duplicates with a validation error naming both locations, and preserves top-level precedence only for explicitly supported migration inputs; canonical serialization strips nested steps.
design_decisions.rationale: Current normalize silently skips duplicate nested IDs against a frozen top-level set, dropping work without error.

verification.evidence: M189 AC-01..AC-09 verified via the locked existing targets; self-review F-01 resolved.

findings.description: Legacy set-spec-status dry-run mutates only spec_status in its preview, so it can report success for a source-state transition that the shared event table rejects on commit (L7 dry-run honesty).

AC-03/L3: event_for_spec_status maps verified→MilestoneEvent::Complete with no gates in gate_errors_for_spec_status. Reproducer: approved milestone + `mp milestone set-spec-status <id> verified` jumps lifecycle draft/groomed-blocked paths aside — from approved it lands lifecycle=complete/spec=verified/exec=done without running complete_milestone gates (AC verify, steps, open findings). Public complete path is gated; this legacy setter is not.

L7: compute_set_status_preview only assigns execution_status in-memory and reports empty gates. Live set_execution_status runs G1/start gates, verified-required for done, terminal refusal, and apply_transition. Reproducers: draft→in-progress dry-run shows success fields+gates=[]; live fails G1. in-progress→done without verified dry-run success; live errors execution_status done requires spec_status verified. Preview also omits lifecycle/overlay flips the transition table would apply.

AC-04 incomplete routing after demoting self-reviewed/reviewed to aliases: add_finding only EnterRemediation for (done|complete)+self findings, or (self-reviewed|reviewed)+external findings. Active destinations are done/complete, so stage-8 external findings on done/complete do not enter remediation (reproducer: complete+external stays complete; done+external stays done). Legacy on-disk self-reviewed+external still enters and collapses pre_state via from_lifecycle→Done. External review on post-M189 milestones never auto-escalates.
findings.summary: External findings on done/complete skip remediation

findings.description: AC-03: MilestoneEvent::MigrateRaw exists only in mp-model (no call sites). set_lifecycle always bail!s migration-only for every caller including bulk. migrate_milestone_file still does m.milestone.lifecycle = new_lc string assignment, bypassing the shared transition executor and the documented MigrateRaw escape hatch (spec.rs comment is false). Migration-only raw path is neither available via CLI nor routed through the transition table.

L7 residual: compute_complete_preview and compute_approve_preview mutate legacy spec/exec (and ACs) without apply_transition, so dry-run omits lifecycle flips. Reproducer: `mp milestone complete <id> --dry-run` fields show only spec_status/execution_status; live writes lifecycle=complete. approve --dry-run similarly shows spec_status ready without lifecycle=approved. Contrasts with bulk set-spec-status dry-run which was fixed to use the transition table (self F-01).

Transition table: Block has no phase guard; Cancel always sets cancelled. Reproducer: lifecycle=complete then `mp milestone block` → complete+blocked+execution_status=blocked; `mp milestone set-status cancelled` → complete+cancelled=true. Terminal delivery phase remains complete while overlays/exec diverge. Spec called for overlay combination validation; complete is not protected the way Defer is (Defer correctly rejects complete).

Group C Finding 4 / S8: remove lifecycle eligibility allowlists from Raul in favor of mp/mp-model projections. DRIVABLE_LIFECYCLES still hard-codes approved/in-progress/self-reviewed/reviewed (plus LIFECYCLE_NODES/FILTER/GAUGE lists). Effective lifecycle derivation was delegated, but eligibility remains a Raul-owned allowlist including demoted review aliases as active drive targets — out of step with reviews-registry ownership of review rungs.
findings.summary: Raul still keeps lifecycle eligibility allowlist

findings.description: Finding 9 residual: nested duplicate IDs across WPs correctly error with both locations, but when a nested id collides with an existing top-level step, normalize silently skips the nested step (top_level.contains) without reporting the nested location. Group C asked to preserve top-level precedence while reporting every conflicting nested location; current behavior is silent drop only (pinned by top_level_steps_take_precedence_over_legacy).
findings.summary: Top-level vs nested step ID conflict silent
